lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Spatial arrangement consists of several vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gills. Each column contains approximately 4-6 visible nodes following the lateral curvature of the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the high-luminance blobs, creating a structured grid pattern across the mid-to-posterior flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant longitudinal ridge is visible across the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high-luminance (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent high-luminance diagonal linear mark is visible posterior to the gill region, extending postero-ventrally toward the pectoral fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, high-intensity linear features localized on the lower flank and near the pectoral fin surface.
